title: Rare Stuffs
description: Adds rare stuff like a powerful axe
body:
This mod in the future will have more features... obviously.

Items:

<details>
<summary>Spoiler</summary>
Iolite | Found in Watch Tower, Used to brew Anti-Gravity Potions and Totems.
Axe of Power | Found in Barrels, A powerful axe, Has a WIP combo feature that stacks up to 10, though it doesnt work.
</details>

Structures:

<details>
<summary>Spoiler</summary>
Watch Tower | New Structure with simple loot, Chance for Iolite to spawn in the chest.
Barrels | New Structure with simple loot, Very Very low chance for Axe of Power to spawn in the chest.
</details>
